title: Tfh, HC_A1, scRNAseq
characteristics_ch1: cell type: follicular helper T cells
extract_protocol_ch1: To characterize the Tfh cells, CD4+ T cells were enriched from the peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) by positive selection using CD4 microbeads (Miltenyi Biotec). Enriched CD4+ T cells were then stained with Abs against CD4, CD3, CD25, CXCR5, and PD-1, and then sorted for Tfh cells, defining as CD4+CD3+CD25−CXCR5+PD-1+. After sorting, cells were suspended in DPBS. Single cells were separated into droplet emulsions according to manufacturer’s instructions (10x Genomics). scRNA-seq was performed according to manufacturer’s instructions (10x Genomics).
data_processing: The demultiplexing, barcoding processing and gene counting were made by using Cell Ranger. The annotation, gene counts filtering and DESeq2 normalization were done by using R and Seurat.
Supplementary files format and content: gz files include features, barcodes, and matrix
